messages:
lina: product reported odd numbers in the cost dashboard: tenant t-421 shows prefetch savings of -$4.50 and per-model unit cost jumping. anyone? :thinking:
omar: saw a spike in model 'redwood-micro' apparent token burn. could be double counting in the 'unit-econ' aggregation stage
jess: is this tied to the quota routing rollout yesterday? we switched sticky routing->multi-route fallback for canaries
ryan: if route tags changed mid-invocation we might end up with two token_event rows (prefetch + fallback). UI currently sums tokens per-row without de-dupe
lina: sample inv inv-0f8b, baseline=300, cached=120, net billed=420 (should be 180)
omar: ah that's the signature of missing dedupe. Also noticed prefetched_credits have model_name null for some records after the quick ETL map change
jess: two fixes: 1) dedupe on invocation_id in the dashboard view; 2) enforce prefetched_credits.model_name via ETL transform so per-model rollups are correct
ryan: low friction hotfix: change materialized view that the dashboard reads from to pre-aggregate by invocation_id and model_name, coalescing credits
lina: can we also add a transient alert in Console if any tenant's per-model unit cost increases >50% day-over-day? product wants early warning
omar: we already have percent-change alerts but they're noisy. maybe gate on sampled top-5 invocations to reduce false positives
jess: adding sampling + deterministic dedupe should make alerting stable. also add a percent-of-prefetch threshold (if credits < 0 or > baseline) to catch ETL regressions
ryan: I'll spin a patch for the view: aggregate per-invocation, coalesce(prefetch_credit,0), and include route_version tag. Push to staging after tests
billing-bot: [smoke] running daily rollup sanity for tenant t-421 on staging...
billing-bot: [smoke] complete: staging shows savings +$3.20, per-model unit-cost back to expected range :white_check_mark:
lina: perfect. ryan, can you file an observability task to add the negative-savings guard (threshold -$1) + per-model delta alert?
ryan: filing now, will include owners eng-platform + cost-reports. also documenting invocation_id dedupe in econ-schema doc
omar: follow-up: long term we should canonicalize prefetch as a single per-invocation attribute during ETL so UI queries are simple
jess: agree. leave thread open until prod deploy completes. thanks team :rocket:
